messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "blood tests usually done 6 to 8 weeks after any dose change"
set: ["blood tests usually done 6 to 8 weeks after any dose change", "children tested 2 weeks after any dose change", "4 weeks after each dose change", "94% after 8 weeks", "97% after 8 weeks", "does not usually change normal blood pressure", "6 to 12 weeks", "blood tests performed every 6 to 12 months once dose is stable", "kidney problems do not usually change your dose", "dose change", "frequent blood tests", "blood liver tests", "blood clotting tests", "8 mg orally every 8 hours after the first dose", "increase should be given no sooner than 6 to 8 hours after the previous dose", "reassess blood pressure after a few weeks"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
